note: VULCAN op-table contract — ONE source of truth for the Godot tool schema, the lite subset, read/mutate/exec permission classes, the addon handler-coverage proof, and the docs. Per-category counts sum to 163; the frontier category sits above it. class: read = never mutates project/editor state; mutate = UndoRedo-wrapped editor edit; exec = runs code / drives input / launches (ask-always). lite marks the 76-op core subset.

args.path: res:// path of the ASSET (its .import sidecar is read)

ops.name: import_set
ops.summary: Set .import [params] keys (smart-parsed) and reimport the asset; the receipt carries each key's previous value (not an editor undo step)

args.params: object of param key -> new value
args.reimport: optional: run the reimport after writing (default true)

ops.name: refactor_rename_signal
ops.summary: Rename a script's signal ONCE: every inspector-wired [connection] in every scene (engine-read, text-applied, reload-verified) + the declaring script's declaration/emits/self-connects; dynamic sites elsewhere are findings. Writes files (not an editor undo step); dry_run plans without writing

args.dry_run: optional: plan + findings only, write nothing (default false)

ops.name: refactor_rename_export
ops.summary: Rename an @export var ONCE: every stored scene/resource override (engine-read, text-applied, reload-verified) + every identifier in the declaring script; other scripts' member accesses are findings. Writes files (not an editor undo step); dry_run plans without writing

args.dry_run: optional: plan + findings only, write nothing (default false)

ops.name: runtime_frames

ops.name: playtest_run

args.screenshot: optional: capture the game viewport at window end (default true)
args.stop: optional: stop the session afterwards (default true)
